items.sentence: That isolated island cabin stands far from any other house.
Our first club meeting felt awkward until everyone shared names.
My friend showed sympathy by repeating my worry and offering help.
The tiny mouse thought the vacuum sound was terrifying.
Even after losing once, our team stayed optimistic about tomorrow.
A sincere apology helped the two friends play together again.
Thick gray clouds mean rain is likely this afternoon.
Desert camels endure long days without drinking any water.
Memory games train cognitive skills such as remembering and comparing.
Still lake water can reflect the mountain and the clouds.
